The Phantasm Zone is a prison dimension within a dimension that flies through the Twisting Nether forever, its occupant able to see out, but never escape. It was crafted by the Kirin Tor to imprison Magnus Manastorm, who had the impossibly rare problem of being more dangerous dead than alive.

phalynx.]] Phalynx are a type of cat-like centurion found in Bastion. Pelodis describes them as efficient, obedient, and easy to work with. Phalynx units excel in combat. They are thoroughly trained in taking foes down by the legs, as well as hunting down beasts gone awry. They have precise detection mechanisms that allow for excellent scouting. The kyrian sometimes use them as mounts, and some among the Ascended keep them as pets. The armored phalynx in particular—a rare marvel of steward engineering—are favorite companions of the Ascended's strongest warriors, since they are both fearless and vicious. Phishing is the criminally fraudulent process of attempting to acquire sensitive information such as usernames, passwords, and credit card details by masquerading as a trustworthy entity in an electronic communication. Phishing is an example of techniques used to fool users. The most common method of phishing is by sending misleading e-mails that point to websites masquerading as legitimate account-holding institutions.

Pillar Deep is a terraced area located toward the northeastern side of the Eye, beneath the Maelstrom. It has many thermal vents releasing steam and gas bubbles. There are hundreds, perhaps thousands, of enormous stone-like columns stretching toward the surface. Surprisingly enough, they are not columns at all but rather colossal tubeworms, grown to gigantism on the acidic gas from the volcanic fissures. Innumerable smaller worms inhabit this area as well.

The Pit of Refuse is located inside Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It is full of bog beasts, oozes, maggots, and worms. It is located directly beneath the Pit of Sacrifice and is accessed either by a long winding stairwell leading from the rightmost passage upon entering through the instance portal or by jumping down from one of the six Hall of Serpents' ledges lining the room. Dropping through the central pit from above will result in a swift death from falling. Upon pressing the snake statues on those ledges in the proper order, the dire troll boss Atal'alarion spawns in the middle of the pit. The altar showing the proper order of the statues sits at the top of the staircase leading down onto the

The Pit of Sacrifice is located inside Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It is accessed by going up the stairs through the leftmost doorway from the instance portal. It is full of dragonspawn and dragon whelps, which must all be killed if one is to face Shade of Eranikus. Along the room are six ledges with the mini-bosses Gasher, Hukku, Loro, Mijan, Zolo, and Zul'Lor, all of whom must be killed in order to face Jammal'an, whom must be killed in order to make Shade of Eranikus attackable. The Pit of Sacrifice contains a hole which leads down into the Pit of Refuse. Falling through here is deadly. The Pit of Narjun is a large sinkhole in western Dragonblight. It is located just south of the derelict taunka capital of Icemist Village. This gaping hole in the land served as the point of entry for the Anub'ar forces of undead nerubians when they invaded and took over Icemist Village. Inside, the pit is filled with the Black Blood of Yogg-Saron, while High Cultist Zangus and many Anub'ar Underlords can be found here. It is also the home to the only known still living nerubians: Kilix the Unraveler and his Azjol-anak Battleguards. The Pit of the Fang is located in the center of Brunnhildar Village, in the southern reaches of the Storm Peaks. Here, the Hyldnir run a competition called the Hyldsmeet, where they battle each other while riding on polar bears, in order to decide which of her should rule with the Keeper Thorim. A vrykul lady can't even enter the competition if she hasn't won at least one duel to the death.

Pirates' Day is an annual world event that takes place on September 19, lasting for one day. From a description on [https://web.archive.org/web/20181005164825/http://us.battle.net/wow/en/game/events/pirates-day the old community site]: :Avast, mateys! Commoners outfitted as scurvy pirates have appeared in all the world’s cities bringing rum news: the Dread Captain DeMeza and her crew have landed in Booty Bay and declared this day to be Pirates’ Day! If you’re brave enough to share her grog, you may have what it takes to become an honorary crew member for the day.

Pilgrim's Bounty is a world event occurring in November, around the time of the American holiday Thanksgiving. Among the activities which occur are cooking, eating and sharing food, food fights, and turkey hunting. Following their introduction to the mainland by the goblins, bush chickens have become the entre du jour for Pilgrim's Bounty due to their high deliciousness and low intelligence.

Part of the meta-achievement for Pilgrim's Bounty. This can be done in one day, like most of the pilgrim bounty achievements. All of these dailies involve handing over a stack of 20 of one of each recipe you get from Bountiful Cookbook (cooking 280 required to learn all the recipes)

This is the meta-achievement for Pilgrim's Bounty. It is not part of the What A Long, Strange Trip It's Been meta-achievement. Completion rewards both the title "pilgrim" and a Plump Turkey companion.

The Pit of Saron is the second wing of the Frozen Halls instances of Icecrown Citadel, released in patch 3.3. The enormous pit in the dungeon is filled with large extracts of saronite ore and the Scourge have taken many Alliance and Horde prisoners forcing them to mine the saronite or face torture and reanimation into undeath. The players help Jaina Proudmoore or Sylvanas Windrunner rescue the prisoners and put a stop to the Scourge's operations and defeat the brutal scourge master of the area and his lieutenants. The Pipe of Franclorn Forgewright is a common dwarf archaeology artifact that requires 45 Dwarf Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to two keystones can optionally be used when completing this artifact.

:The night elves of Darnassus revere nature, so it is no wonder that their signature bread features ingredients foraged from the forests of Kalimdor: wild hive honey, pine nuts, and mixed herbs. Additionally, it is othen formed into the shape of a leaf to honor Teldrassil, the World Tree. Passed down from the night elves' forebears, this ancient recipe makes for a scrumptious accompaniment to pastas and stews.
Pit Vipers are snakes found in the Chamber of Prophecy in the Halls of Origination.
The following NPCs can be found inside the Pit of Saron instance.
Pirate Sinker's Gloves are a quest reward from Circle the Wagons... er, Boats (Horde). The Alliance version is Smooching Gloves
Pirate Sinker's Bracers are a quest reward from Circle the Wagons... er, Boats (Alliance). The Horde version is Bear Hug Bracers
Pirate Booty is a quest item dropped by Southsea Swashbucklers and as a ground drop in Tanaris for Booty Duty and Lootin' Plunder.
The Pillaclencher's Ornate Pillow spawns after the death of Chambermaid Pillaclencher.

Pilgrim's Precipice is an elongated plateau overlooking the Maker's Ascent in northern Uldum. Four Confiscated Artillery units are found stationed here ready to fire at the enemy to clear the way into the Ruins of Khintaset.
Pit Lord Argaloth is a player vs. player achievement earned for defeating Argaloth in Baradin Hold.

__NOTOC__ Pirate Party Crashers are pirates affiliated with the Southsea Freebooters that are intent on disrupting the party going on at the KTC Headquarters pool in Kezan. They were hired by Trade Prince Gallywix.
Ping Pong Champion is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for bouncing the Void of Unmaking 10 times off of players, and then defeat Warlord Zon'ozz on Normal or Heroic difficulty.

Piles of Corpses can be found just inside the Forlorn Cloister of the Scarlet Monastery. Zombified Corpses will occasionally spawn from them, only to be put down by the nearby Scarlet Flamethrowers and Scarlet Centurions.
The Pink Spring Circlet can be purchased from Noblegarden Merchants and Noblegarden Vendors during Noblegarden for .
Pilfered Pumpkins can be found to the east of the Rows proper in the Virmen Grotto, which can be accessed either on the surface or via the Teeming Burrow.
Ping Marlfur is a pandaren found at Stoneplow Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Pink Turnip Seeds can be purchased from for and can be planted at Sunsong Ranch to grow a Pink Turnip. Seeds can also rarely be found while harvesting at the farm.
__NOTOC__ Pink Turnips are a cooking ingredient. They can be found on any yaungol on Pandaria as well as grown at Sunsong Ranch from Pink Turnip Seeds.
Pio is a pandaren residing in Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest. He can be found in the village restaurant, at the first floor, speaking with Mitsua.
Mankrik had to unload his stock of Quilboar Tusks somehow. That's what he gets for still being consumed by hatred.
Pinnacle of Storms is a raid achievement for the bosses in Lei Shen's inner sanctum of Throne of Thunder.
Pistonhammer Gun is a quest reward from Batteries Not Yet Included.
Pirate's Musket is a quest reward from Details of the Attack.

Pilgrimage is an exploration achievement earned for gaining the blessings of all four Celestials by interacting with active Time-Lost Shrines on Timeless Isle. Shrines may only be interacted with by one player, then they will deactivate for roughly 10 minutes before reactivating. There are plenty of shrines all over the isle, so keep looking if they all appear to be inactive!
Piles of Elemental Ash drop from Bloodmaul ogres in Frostfire Ridge during Ashes Of The Past.

Pippers can be found running all over Lunarfall, the Alliance garrison in . Pimple is a toad located at the Pools of Purity in the Valley of the Four Winds.
The Pineapple Lounge Cushion may be found in the Stolen Present under the tree from December 25 to January 2 during the Feast of Winter Veil.
Pip's Shanker drops from Kyrak in the Upper Blackrock Spire (level 90 version).
The Pilgrim's Road is a stretch of road leading from the Anchorite's Sojourn to in eastern Talador.
__NOTOC__ Pit-Extracted Stone Signet drops from Kormrok in .
__NOTOC__ Pip's Flenser drops from Kyrak in Upper Blackrock Spire.

Pinchwhistle Point was a Steamwheedle goblin settlement located at the cape of Arak. The town and the inhabitants were, however, infested by spores from the local fungi and were abandoned. It is now inhabited by infected goblins, fungal creatures, sludges, and a single uninfected goblin, Krixel Pinchwhistle, who was injured while trying to find a cure for the infection. Prior to the infestation, the goblins were harvesting many of the local resources with many lumberjacks and oil pumps found in the area. The Mother Lode zeppelin crashed after surveying the area. Pirate Pepe is a Pepe bird with a pirate outfit on found in the Spires of Arak.
The Pit Slayer is an ogron located next to the Pit Slayer's Trophy at the Broken Precipice in .
Pit Beast is a skyscreamer located near two Pit Beast Handlers at the in . It was imported to from Azeroth by an Exotic Beast Merchant.

Pit Announcers are humans found standing around the fighting pit on the eastern side of Durnholde Keep in Old Hillsbrad Foothills. They drop no loot, give no reputation when killed and don't appear to serve any purpose.
Pip "the Pen" Russlehide is an orc vendor located outside the Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.
Pit Lord's Cuffs drop from General Volroth in the Soul Engine on Mardum.

Pillik is an imp scoutleader of the Burning Legion. He is among the demons summoned by in front of the Tomb of Sargeras during the Battle for the Broken Shore, and later leads an incursion of Lesser Imps at the entrance to the Tomb of the Old Kings on Shield's Rest in Stormheim during Legacy of the Icebreaker.
Pit of the Devourer is a location in the Cracking Plains of Frostfire Ridge. The Borrok the Devourer vignette is found here.

The Pillars of Fate is an area in northeastern Spires of Arak, east of the Howling Crag and south of Anguish Fortress and Gul'var. Remnants of the operate here, and defeating their forces is the objective of Assault on Pillars of Fate.
Piotr Michael is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Pit of Malinoth is a cave named after Malinoth. It is located at the Altar of End Times on the isle of Faronaar in Azsuna. Jarvox is found here.
The Pit of Criminals is an area in the Forgotten Crypt where a pile of skeletons can be found.
Pinchshank is a crab found on the beach outside the Estate of the First Arcanist in Suramar.
Pilfered Night Elf Bones drop from the Salteye murlocs at the El'dranil Shallows in Azsuna.
Pilfered Sweeper can be looted from Curious Wyrmtongue Caches on the Broken Shore. It summons a nightborne construct that companions can jump on.
Pinrose Tribar can be fished from pools of Floating Garbage in Thousand Needles.
Pit Commander Galvinoth is an annihilan located on the Legion Command Ship in Broken Shore.
Pit Felguard are felguard located on the Legion Command Ship in Broken Shore.

Pit Boss Buxdoggle is a goblin located in Brawl'gar Arena. You can speak with him at the start of every brawl and bet on who will win to win additional Brawler's Golds. If your guess is correct, you receive a stackable buff.
Pit Lord Vilemus is an annihilan boss located within a Greater Invasion Point on Aurinor.
Pile of Pants is created from Transmute: Meat to Pants with Alchemy (1).
